purpose: Teach: 侵攻/搾取/転落/談話/快楽/湾岸/丸山/セックス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場への侵攻は慎重に進めろ
lines.en: We need to advance into the market deliberately. Move with caution.
lines.style: Measured authority. Crisp consonants on key words. Level gaze. Not rushed — each phrase lands with intention. The voice of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。下請けへの搾取は絶対しない方針です
lines.en: Yes. We have a strict policy: we won't exploit our subcontractors.
lines.style: Respectful, direct. Brief pause after 'Yes' — absorbing the instruction. Then steady, clear affirmation. Not defensive, just committed. Eye contact held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績の転落を防ぐ手を打て
lines.en: Take action now to prevent our performance from falling.
lines.style: Urgent but controlled. Sharp attack on the verb. Quiet intensity — not theatrical. The tone of someone who sees the problem and expects immediate response.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社長の談話を社内、共有いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll share your statement with everyone in the company.
lines.style: Efficient reassurance. Slight nod in the voice. Rapid but not rushed. The sound of someone taking notes and moving to the next task immediately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧客に快楽を提供する商品開発を進めろ
lines.en: We're going to develop products that bring genuine satisfaction to our customers.
lines.style: Deliberate emphasis on 'satisfaction.' Warmer than the previous directives — there's conviction here, not just order. Slower on the final phrase. A principle being stated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。湾岸エリアの新店舗、検討中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently looking at a new location in the bay area.
lines.style: Informative, engaged. Quick uptake on the shift to product strategy. Upbeat on 'currently' — forward momentum. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、丸山先生をコンサルタントとして招きたい
lines.en: I want to bring in Maruyama-sensei as a consultant.
lines.style: Confident naming. Light pause before the title — respect for the person being brought in. Direct statement of intention. No hedging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。健康商品にセックスレス対策も含めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll include preventative solutions for sexlessness in our health product line.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment. No pause on the clinical term — professional delivery. Thorough, organized. The final confirmation of a plan being locked in.
